svg.title: The same finite calculation gives L (Exp P) = Exp(L P) on the zero-scalar ideal and ∥L P(z)∥w = ∥P(π(z))∥w. Record the flag set and all support–inventory barcodes so that the pattern predicate is pulled back along with its coefficient. The restoration sum then is exactly L X, including zero terms excluded by the predicate. Finally, for the realized probability prior νZ with π∗νZ = ν, coefficientwise integration gives Z [L X]A dνZ = Z [X]A dν.
